errors.says: The packed selected-bit addition runs in O(V(L^tau+1)) time when R exceeds every fixed polynomial in p and K/log p -> infinity.
errors.paper: The family bound O(V(L^tau+1)) also requires A_rect=O(p) and f<=d<=p; the general bound is O(V(L^tau+1)+M A^3+delta_bad M A(R+A)).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: scalar exchange network, frames, nested labels and their dimension budget, the bit shear and complex phase interfaces with s<Wm, the explicit exponent tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, then the interchange and layer recurrences, and finally the synthetic-transform reduction, error budget and cost table with kappa=2^{-182}. The only thin spot is that the elementary stream lemma is quoted rather than derived. Every link of the central saving is present with its quantities.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(100,3), N=v^3, m=h^3=10^6, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by triples (U_a=t_{a1} tensor t_{a2} tensor t_{a3}), and the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all present.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the endpoint frames alone fix each route, so the edges pay only frame changes.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, nested labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V - dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
The sum of |Delta dim| is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, then s_b=W_b m - N + 2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) gives s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role, including P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, so the network applies H<-H+D on every row/role.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, a shear of rank a costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the node makes s recursive calls in all.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan carries the whole central chain with its defining quantities: the h=100 exchange network, frames, labels, rank as dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity I_m, matrix shears costing their rank, and the recurrence with the explicit tau. All nine steps are reconstructed.
